name: Spokeo

steps.note: The opt-out page asks for the URL of the profile, so the listing is found first. This is the search the site's own box in the page header submits, and it takes a name. The box is visible on the capture; the query string behind it was read from that form's own markup on verified_on.
The opt-out page states that a person may have several listings, that each one has its own URL, and that each is opted out individually. This step identifies one listing, not the person.
The page asks for the URL of the profile and gives the format: https://www.spokeo.com/Smith-Sample/Houston/TX/p12345678

steps.prompt: Spokeo shows a checkbox reading I'm not a robot between the email field and the OPT OUT button. Tick it yourself, then say when it is done.
steps.note: Handed over, never worked around. Nothing here solves it.

steps.prompt: The listing URL and the email address are filled in and the checkbox is ticked. Check both values, then say yes to send the opt-out request.

steps.note: The page says a confirmation email follows and that the link in it has to be clicked to complete the process. It does not name the sending address or say how long the email takes, so match on the sender name and read the timeout as a ceiling on waiting rather than a figure from the page.

verification.success_when: The listing URL that was opted out no longer returns that listing. The page states each listing has its own URL, so a listing found at a different URL is another listing rather than a failed removal.

id_requirements.note: The page asks for the listing URL and an email address, and nothing else.

notes: Written from the opt-out page captured on verified_on. Four things that page states and a run depends on. Each listing has its own URL and is opted out one at a time, so a person with several listings runs this once per listing. A request should be processed in 24-48 hours, which the page makes conditional on the nature of the request and the amount of data. The process completes only when the person clicks the link in the confirmation email. Information may reappear later without notice, and the page asks people to check again for new listings. Two wordings, one number: the captured page says 24 to 48 hours, and the page shown after the emailed link is clicked says 2 to 3 days. recheck_after_days is 3, the longer of the two, so a recheck does not go out while the request is still inside the window Spokeo itself quoted last. That second page appears only after a real submission and nobody has captured it; its wording is recorded from a person's run on 2026-09-09 and is not visible on any image in this repository. What the capture shows and what it does not: the labels, the fields, the checkbox, the button, and the site's own search box are all on the image; the css fallbacks in the selectors and the search query string were read from the page's own markup on the same visit, and the image holds no browser address bar, so source_url and optout_url record the address that was open rather than something legible on it.
